excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content:
For strategy 1, there’s also the timing game , if you push `A` too close to the end of the slot, it just gets eaten by timing games anyway.

I missed berlin interop so I don’t have full context or understand why 7732-noPTC was even proposed. These are just my personal thoughts as someone in the pro-PTC camp:

* PTC isn’t the complexity people make it out to be. I implemented it PTC duty in Prysm and reviewed the spec, it’s nowhere near as complex as some have claimed. It’s much simpler than the IL committee in FOCIL, which I also implemented
* PTC enables gossip benefits for delayed execution. Without it, I’m not sure how that would be achieved, especially post-Fusaka, where validators aren’t subscribed to all columns
* PTC is useful because it opens the door for a second committee, which can potentially be reused for FOCIL or other future extensions
